Walmart's net income rose about **2.9%** from fiscal Q1 2025 to fiscal Q4 2025. Walmart's fiscal 2025 ended January 31, 2025.

These figures are recalled rather than checked against the filings. I used net income attributable to Walmart, not consolidated net income, which includes noncontrolling interests. Consolidated net income should give a similar result of about 3%.

| Quarter | Period ended | Net income attributable to Walmart |
|---|---|---|
| Fiscal Q1 2025 | April 30, 2024 | about $5,104 million |
| Fiscal Q4 2025 | January 31, 2025 | about $5,254 million |

Change: (5,254 − 5,104) / 5,104 ≈ +2.9%
